title: Chapter 100 People Watching The Show
content:
Chapter 100 People Watching The Show

Another hour later, it was 3pm.

The people of Wana Village continued to fight and had not eaten anything yet.

Wang Shuo took advantage of the fact that the frequency of beast attacks had decreased and ordered the people to eat some food in batches.

Now all the backpacks could no longer hold the bodies of the beasts.

He could only order some of the smaller ones to be piled up in some open spaces inside the wall.

If the bodies outside the wall were not cleaned up, the beasts would climb up the light wall along the bodies, which would definitely not work.

Another hour later, the number of beasts began to decrease.

On the ranking list, Wana Village ranked first with 8.8 million kills.

The second place was Jiuyuan Village, with 1.3 million kills.

Jiuyuan Village Chief Su Xiu fell into deep thought when he saw the ranking list.

There were a total of 4 bosses besieging Jiuyuan Village, 1 silver and 3 bronze.

He also learned about some of the beasts besieging the village through channels.

As far as he knew, he should be the one with the most bosses.

What is the situation of this Wana Village? Are they all insects and beasts like beetles and ants?

He was a little puzzled!

Wana Village.

Wang Shuo hurriedly filled his stomach and threw himself into the defense of the city wall again.

This battle can be said to be extremely difficult.

Wang Shuo found Duan Wenxi and asked about the consumption of supplies.

The arrow tower has no arrows.

The energy tower should be activated as long as there are energy crystals.

However, due to uninterrupted use, 8 towers have been scrapped.

There was no way at that time. If those huge elite monsters with high health and high defense were not cleared in time, the damage to the city wall would be difficult to estimate.

Wang Shuo could only be cruel and directly destroyed the energy towers based on the principle of firing as many shots as possible.

In the end, he could only leave 2 towers for emergency use.

There were less than 100 thunder bombs left, and they would definitely not be used unless it was a critical moment.

And the bronze crossbow cart had half of its arrows left.

This is reserved for dealing with the boss.

The next battle can only be close combat.

There is no need to replace the light wall with too low durability with the remaining 60 wall defense charms.

Because 90% of the light walls have a durability of less than 2,000 points.

Wang Shuo thought about it and realized that the outer wall could not be defended.

So he asked Suo Yong to place all the remaining wall defense charms on the inner wall, so that another line of defense could be formed.

At this time, to the north of Wana Village, on a small hill near Wadang Mountain.

There were 4 people standing.

The one in the middle, wearing black armor, was outstanding, and there was a fascinating momentum between his eyebrows.

There was no expression on his face, and he silently paid attention to the battlefield in front of him.

In his eyes, although such a battle was very tense, the degree of cruelty of the battle was nothing.

He had witnessed battles that were ten times more cruel than this one.

"Fang Kai, you called us here, didn't you just come to watch this show?"

One of the bald men, with a round head like a big watermelon, glanced at the boy in black armor and said impatiently.

They have been standing here for 2 hours, and they are unsure when they see a group of bosses on the opposite side.

A single bronze boss is a piece of cake for them, and they may even be able to kill it without injury.

But there is no guarantee of victory against the silver boss, even for Fang Kai wearing black armor.

And facing the gold boss, even if they fight together, they have almost no chance of winning.

Especially Brunei on the opposite side, it is a level 30 gold boss.
